description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Migrate PhotoAlbum's Oracle persistence layer to Azure Database for PostgreSQL, including photo storage and database authentication.
tasks.reason: The application currently uses Oracle Database with Oracle-specific JDBC driver, OracleDialect, and BLOB data types. Azure Database for PostgreSQL is the target managed relational database service on Azure, eliminating the need for self-managed Oracle infrastructure.
tasks.requirements: Migrate the JDBC data source, JPA dialect, repository SQL, and schema definitions from Oracle to Azure Database for PostgreSQL. Convert photo storage from Oracle BLOB to PostgreSQL bytea and adapt Oracle-specific SQL to PostgreSQL-compatible syntax. Replace plaintext database credentials with Managed Identity authentication.
